concerns.text: T002 declares `data/openml_ids.txt` (≥60 verified OpenML IDs) and `data/uci_dataset_urls.txt` (≥10 canonical UCI URLs) as 'inputs to this task, not separate tasks', but no task produces them and they are not among the declared inputs of tasks.md. If these files do not already exist in the repo, T002 is unexecutable; either a producing task or an explicit statement that the files are pre-supplied (with a verification of their existence/line counts) is required.

All three tasks key on 'shape strata from T003' / 'one shape stratum', but no task defines how strata are constructed from the measured skewness/kurtosis (binning rule, number of strata, boundaries). An implementer cannot deterministically reproduce the strata, and T006's verification ('all expected ... JSON files exist') depends on the stratum count. Specify the stratification rule (e.g., quantile bins of skewness with named boundaries) or name the stratum set explicitly.

T011 bundles four distinct deliverables — (a) integration test, (b) runtime benchmark, (c) determinism check, (d) results.md write-up — into one task. This is too coarse for per-task verification; split into separate tasks so each has its own single verification command.

Verification demands 're-running the plotting step reproduces byte-identical figures', but matplotlib PNG output embeds non-deterministic metadata (creation timestamps) unless explicitly suppressed and the matplotlib version is pinned. Add the concrete mechanism (e.g., `metadata={'Software': None}` / SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH plus a pinned matplotlib version in requirements.txt) or weaken to content-identical.

T006's verification says 'all expected (3 d × 4 transform incl. baseline × 2 test) JSON files exist' but the output filename pattern `results/power/<effect_size>_<transform>_<test>.json` gives no naming convention for effect-size values (0.2 vs 'small') or the baseline label; the implementer cannot construct the expected file list deterministically. Specify exact filename tokens.
